latest_interim.note: 9M contributive revenue EUR 916.6m (+6.9% reported, +0.2% organic). Q3-26: +11.4% reported / +4.6% organic (France +1.8%, International +27.8% reported / +9.4% organic); scope Q3 EUR 17.2m (Hidronor Chile 12.6m, La Filippa Italy 4.6m). geography.note: Contributive revenue 2025: France EUR 735.1m (63.8%; company says 64%), International EUR 416.9m (36%) - International split by country not extracted (includes Italy, Spain, Germany, Finland/Nordics = Europe; Chile/Peru = LatAm; South Africa; Singapore/Eco). Europe total therefore >=64% but exact not derived. 2026 acquisitions (Hidronor Chile, La Filippa Italy) raise International share (Q3-26 42%).

cash_flow_check.ocf_note: OCF is stated BEFORE interest: the statement adds back 'Coût de l'endettement financier brut' (44.0) to reach 'Marge brute d'autofinancement avant impôts et frais financiers' (211.7); WC inflow +30.7 (2024: +4.9) attributed by the company to 'gestion rigoureuse du DSO et de la politique d'affacturage' (factoring).
cash_flow_check.lease_classification: financing ('Remboursements des dettes de location et charges financières associées')
cash_flow_check.ifric12_note: Investing: increase in loans & financial receivables -23.3 / decrease +3.4; net-debt bridge shows 'Créances concessives IFRIC 12' +18.6 (concession capex financed via dedicated lines and booked as receivables, not PP&E). Company also deducts concession site rehabilitation/maintenance (GER) charges in its recurring cash flow (H1-26: 20.0).
cash_flow_check.hybrid_note: EUR 300m green perpetual hybrid (TSSDI) at 5.87% issued Oct-2025, classified as EQUITY - it is the main reason IFRS net debt fell from 849.7 to 548.8. Coupons (~EUR 17.6m/yr from 2026) are equity distributions, outside FCF.
cash_flow_check.fcf_reconciliation: 226.1 OCF - 109.8 capex + 7.8 disposals - 19.9 IFRIC12/financial receivables - 33.6 interest - 36.7 lease payments - 5.1 NCI dividends = 28.8 (INFERENCE); excluding the +30.7 factoring/DSO-driven WC inflow ~ -1.9; after hybrid coupon pro forma ~ -20. Company 'cashflow opérationnel disponible' = 114.0 (deducts interest incl. lease interest, but not lease principal, IFRIC 12 or dividends).
cash_flow_check.gap_explanation: Lead's ~17% FCF yield comes from OCF (pre-interest, flattered by +30.7 factoring/WC) less capex only. Interest (33.6) and leases (36.7) sit in financing, concession capex sits in financial receivables, and the 2025 WC inflow is non-recurring - together ~EUR 90-120m of the gap. Sustainable equity FCF is close to zero-to-low-single-digit % yield.

claim_checks.claim: Leverage: IFRS leverage >3x by 30-Jun-2027 is a thesis breaker
claim_checks.finding: Bank-covenant leverage 2.3x at 31-Dec-2025 (3.2x in 2024) on adjusted net debt EUR 509.2m (excl. non-recourse and factoring debt) / EBITDA 225.4m; 2.9x at 30-Jun-2026 after Hidronor/La Filippa (net debt EUR 757.4m). Company target IFRS leverage <3.0x at 30-Jun-2027 including pending 'Groupe Flamme'. Excludes EUR 300m hybrid (equity) - including it, leverage at H1-26 would be roughly 4x (INFERENCE). Little headroom.
